name: Morganth
statusNote: Changed in Forever. New rewards: Demonhide Bracers, Shadow Gauntlets. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
After much observation, I have discovered Morganth's plans.

He searches for the Scythe of Elune...and he may have found it!  If he has, then the Redridge Mountains, and the kingdom of Stormwind, will soon feel his dark might.

I am not prepared to pit myself against Morganth, but I fear he must be dealt with now.  So you must enter the Tower of Ilgalar and face Morganth.

Defeat him, and bring me his Pendant of Shadow.  Do this, and the kingdom will owe you much.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have done well, adventurer. In defeating the warlock Morganth, Stormwind is saved from a grave peril.I offer you this reward most humbly. And I would bid you peace, if these were peaceful times.But instead, I will bid you luck with your trials, and victory in the conflicts ahead.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hurry, adventurer, before my fears of Morganth spreading his power are made real!

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 21 to 27, 5,300 XP in all.

quests.name: A Watchful Eye
quests.objectiveText: Take the Glyph of Azora to the Lion Statue near the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.

quests.name: Looking Further
quests.objectiveText: Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep. Find a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.

quests.name: Morganth
quests.objectiveText: Defeat Morganth. Bring his Pendant of Shadow to Theocritus at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.
